title: Ice-induced vibration spectral analysis: response PSD and resonance risk

AC1.description: SDOF natural frequency error <= 1 %; MDOF (>=3 DOF) <= 5 %

sdof.method: peak of |H(f)| on a 40001-point grid vs sqrt(k/m)/(2 pi) (the damped-peak shift f_n sqrt(1-2 zeta^2) is 0.04 % at zeta=0.02)

AC2.description: FRF amplitude/phase vs analytic <= 1 % (<= 5 % near resonance)

AC4.description: resonance criterion identical to analytic criterion over >= 20 points

AC5.description: DEM-style ice load -> response PSD peak vs literature <= 20 %

result.note: frequency validated; amplitude not validated (records not public)

lighthouse.case: A: lighthouse sway mode (Bothnian lighthouse literature anchor)

literature_anchor.source: Norrstrom (1978); Karna & Turunen (1990), Bothnian lighthouse cases
literature_anchor.note: published dominant freq. quoted as a 1.0-1.2 Hz band; original records are not public, so amplitude is not validated

hull_chain.case: B: hull-girder 5-DOF chain, bow ice excitation

provenance.note: payload generated in the worktree; git_commit is HEAD at generation time

verification_paths.AC2: structural.state_space_frf_sdof vs closed form; modal vs direct
